title: Sentri Provider Routes Export — schemaVersion 1
description: B3.5 — Portable representation of a workspace's `provider_routes` rows. Secrets are NEVER serialised — only `apiKeyLastFour` (the masked tail) round-trips so operators can identify which row corresponds to which deployment key, and re-supply the real key out-of-band after import. The schema is forward-compatible: parsers SHOULD accept unknown fields and reject only on `schemaVersion` mismatch.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped on incompatible shape changes. Importers MUST refuse versions they don't understand; a forward-compat shim in the importer can map older versions up.

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the export was generated. Informational only — not used for ordering or dedupe.

workspaceId.description: Source workspace id. Imported into the CALLER's workspace regardless of this value; surfaced only for forensic correlation across workspaces.

id.description: Source-side `provider_routes.id`. Importer IGNORES this field — every imported route gets a fresh id minted by `providerRouteRepo.upsert`. Surfaced for forensic correlation only.

name.description: Human-readable route name. UNIQUE per workspace — importer's `mode` controls collision resolution.

protocol.description: Wire protocol the dispatcher speaks. Mirrors `protocolForProvider.PROTOCOL_MAP`.

baseUrl.description: Optional override of the SDK's default endpoint. `null` means use the SDK default.

model.description: Model id the provider should dispatch against (e.g. `claude-3-5-sonnet`).

apiKeyLastFour.description: Masked tail of the original key for operator identification. Importer treats this as advisory text — the real key is NEVER round-tripped through the export, so operators MUST re-supply it via the rotate-key endpoint after import.

enabled.description: Whether the route is eligible for dispatch.

cacheEnabled.description: Whether dispatch should consult the prompt cache for this route.

cacheTtlSec.description: Cache TTL when `cacheEnabled` is true. `0` is valid (disables caching even with the flag on).

fallbackRouteId.description: Source-side fallback route id. Importer resolves these AFTER all rows land, mapping each id to the freshly-minted id of the matching name. Unresolvable ids (deleted source route, name collision under `skip` mode) collapse to `null` with a note in the import response.

capabilities.description: Persisted capability-probe payload. Re-probed on import (B2.2) so a stale payload never leaks across workspaces — the imported value is overwritten by the post-import probe result.

pricing.description: Operator-set per-Mtok pricing. Honoured verbatim by the importer — pricing is operator metadata, not derived state.
